## Example 4.1 · Monthly compounding {#fm4-example-4-1-c .fm-slide }

Find the total value of an investment if \$8000 is invested at

c) 5% p.a. compounded monthly for 4 years

<p class="booklet-cue">Booklet p. 10–11 · Example 4.1 · Complete your working in the booklet.</p>

::: notes
$r=5/12$, $n=48$. $A=8000(1+0.05/12)^{48}\approx\$9767.16$. Do not enter 0.05/12 and then divide by 100 again.
:::
